categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Julong Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in high-performance polymer new materials and advanced composite materials. Its main product lines include high-performance modified plastics, thermoplastic elastomer materials, carbon fiber reinforced resin-based composite structural parts and assemblies, and bio-based recycled plastic wood profiles. These products serve industries such as automotive and new energy vehicles, high-speed rail and rail transit, communications and electronic electrical, aerospace, medical health, and environmental construction engineering.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer modification technologies including physical and chemical modification methods to enhance plastic properties. It employs dynamic vulcanization technology for thermoplastic elastomers and advanced manufacturing processes for carbon fiber reinforced composites, including hot pressing, liquid molding, winding, and molding. The production of bio-based recycled plastic wood profiles involves extrusion and molding of recycled plastics combined with plant fibers. The company holds numerous patents and has developed proprietary technologies such as high-performance nylon engineering plastics and dynamic vulcanization techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers (both traditional and new energy vehicles), high-speed rail and urban rail transit companies, communications and electronic equipment manufacturers, aerospace enterprises, medical device producers, and environmental construction firms. The company supplies major domestic and international automotive brands including BYD, SAIC Volkswagen, FAW-Volkswagen, and others. Its bio-based plastic wood products are mainly exported to countries like Germany, the UK, Australia, and Thailand.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It has established wholly-owned subsidiaries in the USA (Texas) and Mexico to better serve international customers and expand its global footprint. Overseas sales account for approximately 9% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Julong operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and manufacturing of advanced polymer materials and composite components. It sources raw materials such as nylon and polypropylene directly from manufacturers and petrochemical companies and supplies finished materials and components to downstream manufacturers in automotive, rail transit, electronics, and other industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-performance functional polymer materials, focusing on automotive lightweighting, new energy vehicles, aerospace, and medical applications. R&D priorities include development of special nylons, polyphenylene sulfide (PPS), polyether ether ketone (PEEK), flame retardant, insulating, conductive, thermally conductive, electromagnetic shielding, and biodegradable materials. It also invests in dynamic vulcanization technology, bio-based recyclable materials, and PCR (post-consumer recycled) materials. The company collaborates with universities and research institutes and maintains multiple innovation platforms and laboratories.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-performance modified plastics, thermoplastic elastomers, carbon fiber composite structural parts, and bio-based recycled plastic wood products. The company operates a direct sales model domestically and combines direct and trade sales internationally, providing technical support and customized solutions to clients. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanjing Julong is recognized as a leading Chinese enterprise in the modified plastics industry, especially in high-performance nylon materials for automotive and rail transit applications. It is a major supplier to domestic and international automotive OEMs and rail transit manufacturers. The company holds a strong position in the domestic market with significant technological achievements and national awards, competing with other specialized polymer and composite material manufacturers in China and abroad.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.83 billion, representing a 7.11% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 72.55 million, a 30.94% increase. Total assets reached RMB 2.06 billion, up 25.98% from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with expanding production capacity and ongoing investments in new production lines and overseas facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing Julong emphasizes high-quality, high-performance polymer materials tailored to meet stringent requirements in automotive lightweighting, new energy vehicles, aerospace, and other advanced industries. Its products offer superior mechanical properties, thermal stability, flame retardancy, and environmental sustainability, including bio-based and recycled materials. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, patented technologies, comprehensive technical support, and close collaboration with key customers from product design to application, ensuring customized and innovative material solutions.
